summary: Sekoia attributes zero-click iOS and Android watering-hole exploitation to APT29 while Binance detailed how fake job interviews delivered the malware behind the $6.3B heist; WordPress CVE-2026-119977 hit CISA KEV as a cPGuard supply-chain backdoor, French blood-storage sabotage, a 69GB Philippines POEA breach, and an AI-assisted 3AM school ransomware attack round out fresh exploitation plus GitLab scale, LLMJacking, and the 200-flaw Android bulletin.
